name: CreatePlayerTwoEntryBlend
evidence: measures the two entries of the player's blend record at 0x103C (func_0012CD78 into each entry's +0xC), builds the blend into 0x105C with func_00139038 (stride 0x10, count 2), measures the vectors at 0x23E0 and 0x23F0 the same way and sets both to their average; StartPlayer calls it

name: PlaceOnPathAt
evidence: original assembly: samples a path object's track (+0x34, through its slots 8 and 1) at a wrapped length (WrapModulo) and converts the point and its rotation to world space (func_001280C0, func_00189D38); ComputeTargetArc, StepPlayerOnPath and SetPlayerPath call it

name: StepPlayerOnPath
evidence: original assembly: places the player on its path (+0x2208) at the length 0x2410 (PlaceOnPathAt) and turns it toward the path's rotation (func_00130748, MultiplyMatrices3x3, MatrixToAxisAngle) by the sub-state at 0x2228; StepPlayer calls it

name: ControlPlayerOnPath
evidence: original assembly: moves the player's length along its path (0x2410 to 0x2418) by the stick through the camera (func_001441C0, g_camera), eases it (func_001EA818, ApproachValueWithRamp, WrapModulo), sets the pad-select mode (SetPlayerPadSelectMode) and changes state (SetPlayerState); ControlPlayer calls it

name: PinPlayerToPath
evidence: original assembly: converts the points of the player's path (+0x2208) at its length to world space and pins the player to it with three contacts (CreatePooledContact); ReleasePlayerContacts calls it

name: SetPlayerPadSelectMode
evidence: stores a mode at +0x2718 of the player: leaving -1 takes the world's pad-select flag and shows the counted screen element (AcquirePadSelectFlag, ShowCountedScreenElement), going back to -1 releases and hides them; func_00109488 and func_001D1BB0 call it

name: SetPlayerPath
evidence: original assembly: makes an object the player's path (+0x2208): in state 7 tells the old one (TriggerScriptEvent 3, its slot at 0x70) and the new one (event 2, slot at 0x6C), clears the targets at 0x2200 and 0x2204, finds the player's length on it and moves to state 7 (SetPlayerState); func_00105AB0 calls it
